final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT s.insurstat, COUNT(DISTINCT c.zoneref) AS site_count FROM scanconservation AS c JOIN sites AS s ON c.zoneref = s.zoneregistry GROUP BY s.insurstat), step2 AS (SELECT SUM(site_count) AS total_count FROM step1) SELECT step1.insurstat, step1.site_count, CAST(step1.site_count AS REAL) / NULLIF(step2.total_count, 0) FROM step1 JOIN step2 ON step2.total_count IS NOT NULL
